description:
Manual games allow you to set custom check locations and custom item names that will be rolled into a multiworld.
This allows any variety of game -- PC, console, board games, Microsoft Word memes... really anything -- to be part of a multiworld randomizer.
The key component to including these games is some level of manual restriction. Since the items are not actually withheld from the player,
the player must manually refrain from using these gathered items until the tracker shows that they have been acquired or sent.

v1.1.0.description:
# Major Update
- Made an equivalent version of the apworld which uses the name "CTGPDeluxe" instead of "MarioKart8Deluxe", should that be preferred.
- Added sort-key to all locations so they'll appear in the right order.
- Improved YAML options for enabling/disabling Base Game, DLC, and CTGP Deluxe courses.
- Added YAML option for enabling/disabling DLC characters as items.
- Added YAML option for customizing the number of Gold Trophies required for goal (anywhere from 1 to 50)
- Removed any cup passes from goal requirements, leaving only Gold Trophies.
- Fixed Base Game and DLC cup passes not being excluded if they weren't enabled.
- Changed "Coins" filler item to "Coin".
